model_annotation:
This figure contains two vertically stacked line plots, both sharing the same x-axis label "Steps" and y-axis label "Training Rewards."

The top plot is titled "Easy Training Set." The x-axis represents Steps on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 500, with tick marks at intervals of approximately 100. The y-axis represents Training Rewards on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.4, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Two lines are shown, each accompanied by a light shaded region indicating variability. The blue solid line, labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Easy," starts near approximately 0.05 at step 0, rises with some fluctuation through the early steps, reaching around 0.25 by step 100, and continues to increase with variability, reaching approximately 0.35–0.37 by step 500. The red solid line, labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Easy," also starts near approximately 0.05 at step 0, follows a generally increasing trajectory, and rises to approximately 0.40 by step 500. Both lines show noisy, fluctuating behavior throughout, with the red line generally tracking slightly above the blue line in the later steps.

The bottom plot is titled "Hard Training Set." The x-axis represents Steps on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 500, with tick marks at 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, and 500. The y-axis represents Training Rewards on a linear scale, ranging from 0.00 to 0.20, with tick marks at intervals of approximately 0.05 or 0.10. Two lines are shown. The blue solid line, labeled in the legend (though partially obscured), remains essentially flat at approximately 0.00 across the entire range from step 0 to step 500, showing no discernible increase. The red solid line, labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Hard," also starts near 0.00 at step 0 and remains near zero until approximately step 150–200, after which it begins to gradually increase. By step 300, it reaches approximately 0.10, and by step 500, it reaches approximately 0.20, with a shaded confidence region visible around it throughout the rising portion.
